header.running_head: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Distributes Wealth

blocks.text: Abu Ubaydah (RA) does with the money. (When he also gave all the money to the needy) Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to the people, "Did I not tell you (that these are men of worth)?"
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Distributes Wealth
He Distributes a Large Amount of Money all at Once and Spends in the path of Allaah Everything that Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) Sent to him

Hadhrat Maymoon bin Mahraan reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) once received twenty thousand Dinaars as he was sitting in a gathering. He then distributed all of it before standing up from the gathering. Hadhrat Naafi narrates that when Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) once sent a hundred thousand to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA), there was nothing left of it by the time the year came to an end (he had spent it all in the path of Allaah).[^1]
He Spends Thousands in Cash in a Single day

Hadhrat Ayyoob bin Waa'il Raasibi reports that when he went to Madinah, a neighbour of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) told him, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) once received a sum of four thousand from Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA), four thousand from another person, a further two thousand from someone else as well as a shawl. He then came to the marketplace to buy some fodder for his animal for a Dirham. When he made the purchase on credit, I recalled the large amount of money that came to him and approached one of his slaves. I said to her, 'I wish to ask you something and want you to tell me the truth. Did Abu Abdur Rahmaan (Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)) not receive four thousand from Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA), four thousand from another person, a further two thousand from someone else as well as a shawl?' 'Yes, he did,' she replied. 'Then why did he just buy some fodder on credit for a Dirham?' I asked. She said, 'He had spent all of it (in the path of Allaah) before sleeping. He the put the shawl on his back and also gave that away before returning home.' I then made an announcement saying, 'O assembly of traders! Why are you toiling for this world when Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) received ten thousand proper Dirhams last night and in the morning he is buying a Dirham's worth of fodder on credit?!'"[^2]

Hadhrat Naafi reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) once received twenty odd thousand as he sat in a gathering. Before getting up from the gathering, he had already given it all away together with some more that he added. He continued giving until everything he had was finished. A person then came to him whom he usually gave (but the money was already finished by then).
Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.296).
